meta.description: The evaluation of section 4: the dependency analyses of the Danish Dependency Treebank and of the Prague Dependency Treebank, measured by gap degree and edge degree and checked for projectivity, planarity and well-nestedness. Table 1 prints for each treebank the number of structures at each gap degree and at each edge degree, and the number that are projective, planar and well-nested, over all structures and over the non-projective ones only. Each count is printed with its percentage of the structures it is taken over; the percentages are not recorded, and the study recomputes those the text argues from.
